notes.title: Update!!
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!

Some issues encountered by some players have been fixed. Remember, if you find any issues with the game, please let me know in the discussion section of the Steam page.

-Fix an issue with the Achievements.
-Fixed a weird bug that can happen the first time you get the codebreaker
-Made one of the sneaking "puzzles" easier.
-The log gathered percentage was added to the end screen.
-Issue with the soldiers.

Bye!

notes.title: Thank you, Players!
notes.content:
To everyone who has purchased and played the game, I want to extend a heartfelt thank you! I hope you had as much fun experiencing it as I did creating it.

As a solo developer, I'm aware of some bugs that need fixing, and I'm already working on solutions. Also, the itch.io version will be available very soon.

Once again, a big thanks to all of you who have supported the game!

Please, don't forget to leave a review! Your feedback is invaluable and reviews play a significant role in boosting the game's visibility.

Until next time,

Dan (byDanDans)

notes.title: Added Language support
notes.content:
The release day of "La Sombra" is drawing near, and I'm excited to share some updates with you. Numerous bugs have been addressed, and several new features have been seamlessly integrated. I'm pleased to announce that the latest addition is language support. In addition to English, "LA Sombra" will now be available in Spanish, Portuguese, French, German and Italian.

Please note that while some translations may appear a bit peculiar, rest assured that I am diligently working to refine them. I sincerely hope you find great enjoyment in the game upon its release!

Best regards,
Dan
